info.name: Appen Platform Account Info Workflows API

items.docs: Create a Workflow for processing data via jobs in the core platform or models via the Model Gateway Services.

params.name: workflow_id
params.description: The `id` of a **Workflow** belonging to the **Requestor** or accessible to the **Admin**.

params.name: key
params.description: Your personal Appen API key; used to access the Appen platform. Can be found in your [account settings](https://client.appen.com/account/api). Variable name: `{api_key}`.
